column4: cleat#3511: WorkflowLoader is PostgreSQL-only, so these two tests open a PostgreSQL store via newRunTestStore (testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres)), which skips when no PostgreSQL is configured. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES.
same two tests, same reason: multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES. See the multi-db/mysql line above.
